none.description:
{Magic Mirror}

Reflects hostile spells, redirecting them toward a random enemy unit. The chance of success is {20%}.

basic.description:
{Magic Mirror - Basic level}

Reflects hostile spells, redirecting them toward a random enemy unit. The chance of success is {20%}.

advanced.description:
{Magic Mirror - Advanced level}

Reflects hostile spells, redirecting them toward a random enemy unit. The chance of success is {25%}. The stack also gains a {15%} chance to resist a hostile spell.

expert.description:
{Magic Mirror - Expert level}

All allied stacks reflect hostile spells, redirecting them toward a random enemy unit. The chance of success is {25%}. Allied stacks also gain a {20%} chance to resist a hostile spell.
